page: Microsoft Azure E112iads_v5 is an isolated, memory-optimized virtual machine built on the x86_64 architecture. The server is powered by dedicated AMD EPYC 7763 processors clocked at 3.525 GHz, delivering 112 vCPUs across 56 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading. It features 672.0 GB of system RAM, allocating 6.0 GB per vCPU, alongside 4080 GB of integrated local SSD storage. Hardware virtualization is managed through Microsoft Hyper-V, and the instance operates with dedicated hardware isolation without GPU accelerators.

Benchmark results demonstrate exceptional multi-threaded computational and memory capability. Multi-core evaluations, including stress-ng multi-core and PassMark CPU testing, rank in the top 10 percent of evaluated systems, supported by top-tier throughput in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and PassMark encryption. The PassMark memory benchmark also achieves a top-tier rating, matched by Redis throughput exceeding 101 million SET operations per second. However, single-core metrics—such as Geekbench single-core and single-threaded gzip compression—fall into the middle 50 percent tier, indicating that workload efficiency depends on parallel execution rather than single-thread clock speed. Uncached large-block memory bandwidth similarly registers in the middle tier.

By pairing 112 dedicated vCPUs, a 672 GB memory footprint, and 4080 GB of local SSD space, the E112iads_v5 provides high resource density for workloads requiring intense concurrency and hardware tenancy isolation. The configuration is well suited for large in-memory databases, distributed Redis caches, demanding relational database engines, and parallel compilation or ETL pipelines requiring substantial fast scratch storage.
description: Microsoft Azure E112iads_v5 is an isolated memory-optimized instance engineered for large-scale enterprise workloads requiring substantial memory density and multi-core throughput. Built on the x86_64 architecture, it is powered by an AMD EPYC 7763 processor running at 3.525 GHz, providing 112 dedicated vCPUs across 56 physical cores. The instance pairs 672.0 GB of system RAM with 4080 GB of high-speed local SSD storage, managed under Microsoft Hyper-V without GPU acceleration. Benchmark assessments highlight top-tier performance in multi-core metrics, including stress-ng multi-core execution, PassMark CPU and memory evaluations, and multi-threaded decompression, alongside robust Redis throughput exceeding 101 million operations per second. While single-thread processing and uncached memory bandwidth show mid-tier results, the server offers high parallel computing capability and resource isolation. This profile makes it well suited for large in-memory databases, enterprise caching layers, heavy database operations, and high-concurrency batch processing.
